criteria.label: Requirement maturity
criteria.expected_outcome: Identification request remains distinct from purchase.

checkpoints.outcome: Keep request at identification/technical-review stage, collecting model/serial/photo/rating/test basis rather than calling it ordered.
Assign engineering owner to verified cause and usable specification/question for supplier/manufacturer.

criteria.label: Equivalence
criteria.expected_outcome: Supplier assertion does not establish a suitable substitute.

checkpoints.outcome: Require technical review of voltage, controls, physical fit, duty and supersession changes before accepting alternative.
Separate customer specification/approval and commercial/warranty consequences from technical recommendation.

criteria.label: Supplier and spend
criteria.expected_outcome: Restricted approval and diagnostic scope are respected.

checkpoints.outcome: Escalate supplier use outside approved category or select appropriately approved supplier.
Keep purchase on hold until customer/Frostline commitment authorities or explicit manager-owned exposure decision are evidenced.

criteria.label: Readiness
criteria.expected_outcome: Tomorrow remains provisional until dependencies are sufficient.

checkpoints.outcome: Do not represent quotation/identification enquiry as ordered, acknowledged or received stock.
Confirm exact part/availability/reservation, shutdown/access and competence before firm return attendance.

criteria.label: Owned continuation
criteria.expected_outcome: The isolated plant and procurement wait are actively controlled.

checkpoints.outcome: Record safe isolated condition, technical/approval/supply dependencies and named chase/review/escalation.
Tell customer verified unknowns, alternatives being checked and next update without promising tomorrow repair.

acceptable_alternatives.outcome: Further diagnosis, original compatible part, or reviewed substitute may each be correct; emergency substitution still needs explicit safe suitability and scoped authority.

prohibited_outcomes.outcome: Purchase/fit the changed-interface fan on supplier assurance alone or outside current technical/customer/Frostline authority.
Mark the distributor identification enquiry as confirmed ordered/delivered and promise a ready repair from it.

critical_failures.outcome: Purchase/fit the changed-interface fan on supplier assurance alone or outside current technical/customer/Frostline authority.
